english.note: Use this neutral descriptive phrase when you want to say simply that someone is an optimistic person.

examples.english: My younger sister is an optimist and believes she will find a job soon even if she becomes unemployed.
examples.traditional: 我妹係個樂觀嘅人，就算失業都相信好快搵到工。
